* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rebellions Are Built On Hope (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-rebellionsarebuiltona57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/rebellionsarebuiltonhope.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/rebellionsarebuiltonhope.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Haven” → “Haven” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Haven”. It is the current full-face image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Deploy on table. Your Force generation is +1 at docking bays you occupy. Once per game, may ▲ one Dantooine, Mon Calamari, or Yavin 4 system or ''Profundity''. Staging Areas is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”
